SYNTHETIC_STATUS.meaning: generator topology calibration is suspended until the real-data scientific lane decides the calibration target, estimand and weighting, because the pooled real envelopes mainly measure cohort composition. The world builder's measurement structure is repaired (S146, S147), component detect/reject holds on repaired worlds, and the adapter is repaired and integration-verified. Runtime, optimizer and EMA work belongs to the runtime lane (PRs 221-223), not this branch.

adapter three-state semantics and value-independent targets (adaa07fe, 2f5e394c)
matched scoring reproduces the real calibration byte-identically (3edc982e)
component detect/reject on repaired support: 3 detect, 4 reject; B4 more recoverable than designed (2038c4f2)
not_qualified: any generator as matching real biology
the real detection envelope as a biology target
the pooled expression envelope and T1-T5 as biology targets (composition-dominated, measured)
the within-cohort measurements as a target or acceptance rule (candidate diagnostic only; S159 open)
